[SWS_DM_00277] Cancellation of a Diagnostic Conversation in case of External Service Processing
⌈
On Cancellation of a Diagnostic Conversation
in case a diagnostic request is currently processed on this Diagnostic Conversa-
tion by a service processor external to the Diagnostic Server instance, the
Diagnostic Server instance shall notify this external service processor, that the
processing for this service shall be canceled according to [SWS_DM_00577].
⌋
